Additional synonyms recognized by the World Register of Marine Species include Latiromitra specialis Locard, 1897 and Teramachia chaunax Bayer, 1971 (WoRMS Editorial Board 2024). This species inhabits tropical deep-sea environments and is found at substantial ocean depths typical of many neogastropods. Its classification within Caenogastropoda, Neogastropoda, and the superfamily Turbinelloidea is supported by taxonomic data curated by WoRMS.
